body.p: Patients wait 11 days for a new appointment and hold times average eight minutes.
Three schedule systems cannot share open slots.
Staff lose time moving between screens.
One platform, one booking workflow, one set of rules for all nine sites.
Your manager shows you the steps before go-live.
Patient care itself does not change.
Role-based training, a champion on every floor and extra help for four weeks after launch.
Questions go to your floor-walker first.

body.text: One schedule, easier access for every patient.
Use these words in every briefing, huddle and email. Local examples welcome; new claims are not.

body.text: Each site champion leads a cell of four to five super users who sit on the floor and answer questions in real time.

items.title: Sponsor
items.text: Removes blockers, speaks at every town hall, owns the go/no-go vote.

items.title: Change lead
items.text: Runs the network, tracks adoption and reports weekly to the steering committee.

items.title: Champions
items.text: Two hours a week; coach peers, gather feedback, relay local risks.

items.title: Super users
items.text: One hour a week; first-line help and a daily tip for their floor.
